body.name: Hans, the woodcutter
body.detail: The throat is opened — ragged tearing, not a clean cut. Fang-work. The face is calm; he did not see it coming.

axe.name: The fallen axe
axe.detail: A good axe, recently sharpened. He was felling, not fighting. Whatever took him surprised him at his work.

briar_fur.name: A tuft of fur on the briar
briar_fur.detail: Coarse fur. Grey at the root, silvering at the tip. Oily to the touch. About four fingers long.

dirt_churned.name: Churned dirt around the body
dirt_churned.detail: The ground is torn up in a wide arc around the corpse. Whatever killed him paced, or circled.

paw_print.name: A pawprint in the trail mud
paw_print.detail: Broader than a man's palm. Four toes, wide splay, a heel-pad too long for a true wolf. The track disappears into bracken — and never returns to four-legged form.

small_track.name: Smaller tracks beside the trail
small_track.detail: Dainty four-toed prints. A fox passed this way recently. The tracks do not approach the body.

broken_branch.name: A snapped branch over the trail
broken_branch.detail: Snapped at chest-height. Something tall pushed through here.

cloak_scrap.name: A torn scrap of brown cloak
cloak_scrap.detail: Heavy brown wool. Peasant cloth. There is a long grey-silver hair caught in the wool.

bed.name: The bed, unmade
bed.detail: The blankets are turned back, hastily. He rose in haste, perhaps to a noise.

meal.name: A half-eaten supper
meal.detail: Bread, cheese, an onion. He was eating when he left.

drawing.name: A child's scratchings on a slate
drawing.detail: A drawing of a man with an axe and a small girl. The widow said there was no daughter. There was.

journal.name: A page from his ledger
journal.detail: "The grey came again last night — I heard it howl long. Hans says do not fear. I do not believe Hans."

innkeeper.name: The innkeeper, mopping the bar
innkeeper.detail: "Hans the woodcutter? Drank here Tuesday. Quiet man. He had words with Karl the trapper at the back."

trapper.name: Karl the trapper, in his cups
trapper.detail: "Hans? He said his neighbour was a man with too-long teeth in the moon-time."

farmhand.name: A frightened farmhand by the fire
farmhand.detail: "I heard it. A howl, low and long, then nothing. Then a howl right close."

notice.name: A posted notice
notice.detail: "BY ORDER OF THE BAILIFF: a reward of twenty pieces silver to any man who slays the wolf."

knife.name: A discarded knife in the alley
knife.detail: A short knife, blade snapped clean. Tavern-brawl detritus.

miller_body.name: The miller, by the wheel
miller_body.detail: His ribs are stove in. The chest is concave — crushed, not torn. No blood at the throat, no fang-mark.

millstone.name: A grain-sack, ripped open
millstone.detail: A heavy sack of barley, torn down its full length — not cut, ripped.

flour_print.name: A great pawprint in the spilled flour
flour_print.detail: Five thick claws, blunt. The print is plantigrade — the heel touches as well as the toes.

cracked_beam.name: The cracked rafter overhead
cracked_beam.detail: A timber as thick as your thigh, cracked clean. Whatever did this stood up to do it.

bear_tooth.name: A carved boar-tooth on the floor
bear_tooth.detail: A boar-tooth amulet on rough twine, the twine snapped. Three notches cut into the bone.

prentice.name: The half-mad prentice
prentice.detail: "It came in through the door. It stood up. I saw the eyes, brown like a man's, and then the hands came down on him."

mill_journal.name: The miller's ledger
mill_journal.detail: "Owe Bernholt the bear-farmer twelve pieces for the spring grain. He grows wroth."

wife_bed.name: The miller's wife, weeping
wife_bed.detail: "My husband has been afraid these three weeks. Of Bernholt, mostly. There was a boy too — his grandson — he'd started watching."

scales.name: The grain-scales
scales.detail: The weights have been altered. The miller WAS cheating his customers.

hearth.name: A cold hearth
hearth.detail: The fire is out. A jar of honey sits on the hearthstone.

bank_tracks.name: Pawprints down to the water
bank_tracks.detail: The same broad, plantigrade prints. They walk in — and walk out the far side.

bank_fur.name: Brown shag on the willow
bank_fur.detail: A clump of fur. Coarse and brown and oily, longer than wolf-hair.

fish_basket.name: A spilled fish-basket
fish_basket.detail: Trout dumped on the bank, half-eaten. The bites are big.

mill_innkeep.name: The downstream innkeeper
mill_innkeep.detail: "Bernholt was muttering about teaching the miller a Roh-Hatz lesson. His grandson Otto was with him, listening hard."

mill_drunkard.name: A drunkard nodding by the fire
mill_drunkard.detail: "Heard a roar two nights back. A great roaring like an old oak coming down."

bailiff_notice.name: A bailiff's notice
bailiff_notice.detail: "Reward of forty pieces silver for the killer of Friedrich the Miller."

hidden_purse.name: A coin-purse, tucked under the bench
hidden_purse.detail: Six silver pieces. New-minted. Hidden, not lost.

c3_neck_wounds.name: Fang-marks on the neck
c3_neck_wounds.detail: Two small puncture wounds on the side of the neck — fang-shaped, roughly 4mm apart. Barely visible without close inspection.

c3_missing_rings.name: Three rings, missing
c3_missing_rings.detail: Ernst's guild seal, a gold band, and a garnet signet — gone from his fingers. No signs of a struggle suggesting robbery.

c3_hollow_torso.name: The collapsed torso
c3_hollow_torso.detail: The victim's chest is oddly sunken — ribs intact, but internal cavity feels soft and hollow when pressed. Organs partially dissolved.

c3_grey_hair.name: A grey-black hair
c3_grey_hair.detail: A single grey-black hair caught on the brass fitting hook beside the mirror. Too long and fine to be Ernst's.

c3_chemical_smell.name: A sweet-chemical smell
c3_chemical_smell.detail: A faint sweet-chemical smell lingers near the body — not perfume, not rot. Somewhere between the two.

c3_lock_scratches.name: Scratches on the back-door lock
c3_lock_scratches.detail: Scratch marks on the inside of the back door lock — picked from the outside, recently.

c3_unsigned_note.name: An unsigned note
c3_unsigned_note.detail: Tucked under the counter: 'You owe what was promised. Tonight.' Written in a rough hand.

c3_lena.name: Lena, the apprentice
c3_lena.detail: "A well-dressed woman came in two evenings ago. Ernst turned away his last appointment for her alone. She was striking — dark hair, very pale skin. She kept glancing at his hands. At his rings."

c3_georg.name: Georg, the neighbour
c3_georg.detail: "I heard voices from the shop around eleven. A woman's laugh — low, soft. Not unpleasant. Then silence."

c3_marta.name: Marta at the lodging house
c3_marta.detail: "A woman matching that description took a room here three days ago. Paid in advance. Her trunk is still here — full of men's jewellery. There was a strange smell from her room. A single grey glove on the windowsill — the fingers were split at the tips."

c3_lodge_elder.name: The Eisbiber lodge elder
c3_lodge_elder.detail: "Ernst wasn't the first. Young Pieter the silversmith — same thing, two months ago. And the clockmaker's son before that. All found peaceful. All drained. All missing their finest pieces."

c4_body.name: Willem Roth, in the snow
c4_body.detail: Deep claw lacerations across chest and shoulders. Expression of pure terror. Body partially dragged then abandoned. One boot missing.

c4_claw_spacing.name: The claw spacing
c4_claw_spacing.detail: Claw spacing on chest wounds is 28cm — far beyond any natural wolf or bear. Pattern consistent with a single swipe from a large bipedal attacker.

c4_musk_scent.name: A musk in the air
c4_musk_scent.detail: A smell of wet fur and iron around the attack site — distinct, not a natural forest smell. Strongest at the point of first contact.

c4_red_eyes.name: Red eye-shine at the treeline
c4_red_eyes.detail: A witness saw red eye-shine at the treeline around 10pm — too high off the ground, too steady for an animal.

c4_missing_boot.name: A boot, found deeper in
c4_missing_boot.detail: Willem's boot found 200 feet deeper in the forest — the drag was abandoned when the attacker heard something. A church bell rang at 11pm.

c4_coat_fabric.name: Torn coat-cloth on a branch
c4_coat_fabric.detail: Heavy dark wool caught at chest height — not the victim's. Coarse, quality cut.

c4_contract_note.name: A contract dispute notice
c4_contract_note.detail: Willem had recently won a case against the local miller, cutting him from a grain route. Threats were made.

c4_child.name: A child near the treeline
c4_child.detail: "I saw a big man go into the trees right before I heard the screaming. He walked funny — hunched, like his back hurt him."

c4_innkeeper_4.name: The innkeeper
c4_innkeeper_4.detail: "Karl Metz was in here until half-nine. He seemed agitated. Kept looking at the door. And his eyes — the firelight caught them strange. Almost red."

c4_karl.name: Karl Metz, at his door
c4_karl.detail: "I was walking home. I heard something. I ran." His hands are trembling. There are scratches on his knuckles he keeps hiding in his sleeves.

c5_compression.name: Compression fractures, no bruising
c5_compression.detail: Every rib fractured — but no bruising on the skin. Force was distributed evenly, applied slowly and with sustained pressure rather than impact.

c5_sinuous_trail.name: A sinuous trail in the dust
c5_sinuous_trail.detail: Faint parallel tracks in the dust — a sinuous trail leading from the drainage gap in the far wall to the barrels. About 40cm wide.

c5_widened_gap.name: A widened drainage gap
c5_widened_gap.detail: The drainage gap in the wall has been widened recently — mortar scraped away from the edges. Something large passed through it.

c5_shed_scale.name: A shed scale
c5_shed_scale.detail: Translucent, about 3cm, faintly iridescent — caught on the barrel hoop. Not from any fish kept in this building.

c5_ledger_note.name: The ledger — 'ask Felix'
c5_ledger_note.detail: Petra's ledger has a discrepancy flagged: a large sum that didn't balance. She had written 'ask Felix' in the margin.

c5_wax_impression.name: A wax key impression
c5_wax_impression.detail: A wax impression of the cellar key, found in a desk drawer in the office above. Recently made.

c5_boss.name: The wine merchant
c5_boss.detail: "Petra told me last week she'd found something in the accounts she couldn't explain. I told her to leave it alone."

c5_delivery_boy.name: A delivery boy
c5_delivery_boy.detail: "I saw someone near the back of the building around five. Big, kind of low to the ground. Moved strange. I thought maybe they were drunk."

c5_wesen_contact.name: A Wesen contact
c5_wesen_contact.detail: "There's a Lausenschlange been in this quarter for months. They hunt Mauzhertz — old instinct. If one was in that cellar it was waiting long before Petra came down."

c6_cold_body.name: The impossibly cold body
c6_cold_body.detail: Lord Fenn's body is abnormally cold — well beyond what time of death and a warm room can explain. Internal temperature suggests frozen from within.

c6_copper_smell.name: Burnt copper in the air
c6_copper_smell.detail: A faint smell of burnt copper — not from the candles. Something else was combusted in this room recently.

c6_biest_mark.name: The biest mark
c6_biest_mark.detail: A small dark U-shaped mark found under the victim's tongue — looks like a birthmark. The biest mark — present in all Hexenbiester, living and dead.

c6_half_letter.name: A half-written letter
c6_half_letter.detail: On the desk, addressed to 'V.': 'She has been asking questions about the eastern routes. I believe she is —' The sentence ends there.

c6_womans_glove.name: A glove — monogrammed M.V.
c6_womans_glove.detail: Fine leather, grey, very small. Found behind the bookcase. Monogrammed 'M.V.'

c6_inheritance.name: The inheritance dispute
c6_inheritance.detail: The butler reports a dispute between Lord Fenn and his nephew over the estate inheritance three weeks prior. Public threats were made.

c6_butler.name: The butler
c6_butler.detail: "A woman came to dinner last week. Beautiful. Dark hair. Lord Fenn seemed captivated afterward — distracted, almost dreamy. When I passed back her wrap, I touched her hand. It was cold. Unnaturally cold."

c6_wesen_contact.name: A Wesen contact
c6_wesen_contact.detail: "M.V. — Marta Vaal. Verrat operative. A Hexenbiest. If Fenn was about to expose her in a letter, she'd have been sent to close him."

c7_jakob_body.name: Jakob Weiss, at his table
c7_jakob_body.detail: Two clean parallel cuts at the throat — surgical, not ragged. Curve inward. He was seated when it happened. No sign of a struggle.

c7_vault_open.name: The empty vault
c7_vault_open.detail: Undamaged lock — the vault was opened with a key, or something that fit exactly like one. Three hundred silver pieces gone. A velvet purse.

c7_surgical_cuts.name: The wound geometry
c7_surgical_cuts.detail: Narrow parallel cuts, 8mm spacing, curving inward. Not a blade. A claw — small, controlled, deliberate. Not frenzy. Not hunger.

c7_fine_claw_mark.name: A fine scrape on the doorframe
c7_fine_claw_mark.detail: Four fine points, close together, 4cm spread — inside the back door frame. Small paw, recently made. Whatever left went out the back.

c7_missing_trophy.name: The gold chain — taken
c7_missing_trophy.detail: The heavy chain he wore every day is gone from his neck. The vault money matters. The chain mattered more — it was personal.

c7_dainty_prints.name: Dainty prints in the rear yard
c7_dainty_prints.detail: Small four-toed prints in the soft earth — not a dog, not a true fox. Something that walks sometimes on two legs, sometimes four.

c7_dropped_coins.name: Coins near the gate
c7_dropped_coins.detail: Three silver pieces scattered near the gate — dropped in haste. Whoever left took too much to carry safely.

c7_gate_scrapes.name: Fresh scratches on the rear gate
c7_gate_scrapes.detail: Fine parallel scratches at mid-body height on the gate latch. Whatever left went over or through it at speed.

c8_rolf_body.name: Rolf Huber, at the channel
c8_rolf_body.detail: Two small puncture wounds at the side of the throat, 12mm apart. The skin around them is greenish-tinged. Expression calm — no time for fear.

c8_green_scales.name: Green scales in the grate
c8_green_scales.detail: Three small scales caught in the channel grate — translucent at the edge, faintly iridescent. Not from any fish kept in this district.

c8_bent_grille.name: The bent iron grille
c8_bent_grille.detail: The drainage grille has been bent outward from inside — recently. Something large navigated this passage. Knew the route.

c8_belly_trail.name: A sinuous belly-drag in the mud
c8_belly_trail.detail: A flat, sinuous trail pressed into the mud at the channel edge — about 30cm wide. Something moved here on its belly, and recently.

c8_cold_stones.name: Cold stones near the water
c8_cold_stones.detail: The stones around the culvert mouth are colder than the air allows. Cold-blooded things chill what they rest on for long periods.

c8_watch_log.name: The watchman's duty log
c8_watch_log.detail: Rolf checked the east culvert every night at the tenth hour without variation — for six weeks. His schedule was perfectly predictable.

c8_guard_account.name: The relief guard
c8_guard_account.detail: "Rolf had been complaining about something in the culvert all last week. Said it smelled wrong — cold mud and something chemical. I told him it was tannery runoff."

c8_wesen_8.name: A Wesen contact
c8_wesen_8.detail: "A Skalengeck hunts by ambush — cool blood, patient waiting. The venom is fast. Give it a dark, enclosed, wet space and it will wait there for days."

c9_crushed_burners.name: Three charcoal burners, crushed
c9_crushed_burners.detail: No blade wounds, no fang marks. Ribcages stove in from sustained pressure — force distributed, not impact. One man's spine broken in three places.

c9_charcoal_prints.name: Huge prints in the snow
c9_charcoal_prints.detail: Five wide-splayed claws, a heel that touches the ground — the same as a bear's, but the stride length is a man's. Something tall walks on two legs here.

c9_snapped_birch.name: A birch snapped mid-height
c9_snapped_birch.detail: A winter-hardened birch, two hands around, broken clean at chest height and thrown aside. The force required exceeds any natural predator.

c9_moved_body.name: A body moved after death
c9_moved_body.detail: The third man was dragged 20 feet from where he fell — the groove is clear in the snow. He was examined, not fed upon.

c9_honey_scent.name: Honey on the equipment
c9_honey_scent.detail: The lead burner's equipment carries a fresh, strong honey scent — not his own. Something that handles honey was close to him recently.

c9_survivor.name: The fourth worker, fled
c9_survivor.detail: "I was fetching wood from the cart. I heard a sound like a tree coming down. Then another. Then quiet. It had brown eyes — man's eyes — in something that was not a man."

c9_debt_note.name: A debt note in the satchel
c9_debt_note.detail: "The Ottmar family owes seven measures of charcoal. Last warning." Signed with a rough bear-claw mark.

c9_wesen_9.name: A Wesen contact
c9_wesen_9.detail: "A Jägerbär in Roh-Hatz does not kill from hunger. This was punishment. The burners wronged something sacred to a Jägerbär family. Find what was taken from them."

c10_heinrich_body.name: Heinrich Braun, in his chamber
c10_heinrich_body.detail: No wounds anywhere on the body. His chest feels oddly hollow — ribs intact, but the internal cavity gives under pressure. Expression perfectly serene.

c10_chain_missing.name: The missing family chain
c10_chain_missing.detail: A heavy gold chain — family heirloom, seventeen years old — gone from around his neck. His coin, his trade ledgers, untouched. Only the chain was taken.

c10_neck_fang.name: Two tiny fang-marks
c10_neck_fang.detail: Two small puncture wounds on the side of the neck, 4mm apart. Barely visible. The skin around them is slightly discoloured.

c10_dark_hair.name: A long dark-grey hair on the bedpost
c10_dark_hair.detail: A single long, fine grey-black hair caught on the bedpost. Not his wife's colour, not his.

c10_sweet_smell.name: A sweet-chemical smell
c10_sweet_smell.detail: A faint sweet-chemical smell in the chamber — not perfume, not rot. It lingers around the body specifically.

c10_wife_10.name: Margit Braun, his wife
c10_wife_10.detail: "She came twice this week. Beautiful — dark hair, very pale, almost grey. Heinrich would not tell me her name. He looked at her the way men look at something they know is wrong."

c10_vendor_10.name: A cloth stall vendor
c10_vendor_10.detail: "She was at the market the last three days. I tried to speak with her. She smiled — very pleasantly — but I could not remember the conversation afterward."

c10_wesen_10.name: A Wesen contact
c10_wesen_10.detail: "A Spinnetod feeds every few years to arrest rapid aging. She chose Heinrich because he was wealthy and wore his valuables openly. She moves after each feeding — she will not be local long."
